intent: Cross the formal garden, enter the glasshouse’s high interior, pass through maintenance tunnels, and leave along its roof. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The formal garden
sections.lesson: Jump between the planted borders. Green is open. Amber warns before the press falls.
